comparison.objective: Connect and lock a garden-hose quick-connect fitting.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxially align and insert a nipple while retracting/releasing a spring collar so pawls engage its groove.
comparison.success_condition: Fitting seated, collar returned, lock retained under a 10 N pull check, assembly still, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Its core mechanism is spring-collar-assisted coaxial insertion and latching; the candidate rotates and screw-locks an adjustment collar, then evaluates impacts.
